metaDescription: Supabase is an open-source Postgres development platform with a database, authentication, storage, edge functions and realtime. See its features, Free, Pro, Team and Enterprise pricing, strengths, limitations and alternatives.
overview: Supabase is an open-source backend platform built on Postgres. Every project gets a full Postgres database, plus auto-generated APIs, authentication and user management, file storage, Edge Functions and realtime subscriptions, so you don't have to stitch together separate services.

Security uses Postgres Row Level Security, enforced in the database rather than in app code, and vector embeddings support AI features. You can use the hosted platform or self-host Supabase with Docker. The free plan suits passion projects; paid plans are billed per organization, with compute billed separately for each project.

features.title: Postgres database
features.text: A full, portable Postgres database for every project, with extensions and daily backups.

features.title: Authentication
features.text: User sign-ups and logins with email, phone and social providers, secured with Row Level Security.

features.title: Data APIs
features.text: Auto-generated APIs let you query your data without writing separate server code.

features.title: Storage
features.text: Store user uploads and media, governed by the same kind of policies as your data.

features.title: Edge Functions
features.text: Serverless TypeScript functions on Deno, distributed globally close to your users.

features.title: Realtime and vectors
features.text: Listen to database changes and broadcast events, and store embeddings for AI features.

useCases: Backends for web and mobile apps
Realtime features such as chat and live updates
AI apps that need vector search
Teams that want a self-hostable, open-source backend
strengths: Open source, with the option to self-host using Docker.
Built on standard Postgres, so your data is portable.
Database, auth, storage, functions and realtime in one platform.
A free plan with unlimited API requests and 50,000 monthly active users.
limitations: Free projects pause after 1 week of inactivity, with a limit of 2 active projects.
The free plan includes only a 500 MB database and 1 GB of file storage.
Compute is billed per project on top of the plan; extra projects start at $10/mo.
SSO and industry certifications need the Team plan, from $599/mo.
Usage beyond plan quotas is billed per metric, which needs some monitoring.

pricing.summary: Free plan available. Paid plans are per organization and include $10/mo in compute credits, which covers one Micro project; each extra project adds its own compute cost. Prices are in USD.
